text:
Alex G: Heads-up — starting ~1782504300 we're seeing a sharp tail-latency increase in us-east-1 GPU pool (gpu-pool-3). p95/p99 spikes ~2-3x for generation endpoints. Traces point to KV cache churn after yesterday's runtime rollout.

Priya R: Confirming — which rollout id? I saw a batching policy tweak landed last night (rollout: r-2026-03-17-09).

Miguel S: Yup that rollout introduced the new continuous-batching heuristic and an aggressive KV eviction TTL change. Could be causing more cache misses + bigger batches = head-of-line latency.

Sam T: Reproduced locally against a small repro: when cache miss rate goes >30% latency jumps. Logs: 
```
[2026-03-17T09:12:34Z] evict: prefix_hits=12 prefix_misses=48 ttl_adj=short
[2026-03-17T09:12:34Z] batching: batch_size=64 -> 256 (upshift)
[2026-03-17T09:12:34Z] kv_cache: miss_penalty_ms=48
```

Taylor H: Can we roll back the batching heuristic immediately? If not, we should throttle batch upshift and evict less often.

Alex G: Oncall, can you cut traffic to us-east-1 while we triage? Prefer gradual shift not to overload other regions.

ops-bot: Scaling action executed: routed 20% of traffic from us-east-1 -> us-west-2 at 1782504365.

Priya R: I'll prepare an emergency hotpatch to force old batching policy (flag: runtime.enable_continuous_batching=false) and revert TTL change. If we patch, we should deploy canary to one node first.

Miguel S: Sound plan. Also suggest evicting recent problematic prefixes from KV to avoid repeated cold-start storms: `kvtool evict --pool gpu-pool-3 --prefix recent-gen` (will free ~30GB).

Sam T: Running evict now on one shard to gauge effect. `kvtool evict --shard s-12 --prefix recent-gen`

deploy-bot: Deploy r-rollback-2026-03-17 queued to gpu-runtime-canary at 1782504410.

Alex G: Good. After canary green, do a controlled rollout to remaining nodes and gradually shift traffic back. Keep cost in mind — shifting too much to west could hit reserved capacity.

Taylor H: Noted — us-west-2 has limited burst slots. We'll throttle traffic shift to max 40% and watch queue depths. Command I'm running: `infractl route shift --from us-east-1 --to us-west-2 --percent 20 --max-queue 200`

Miguel S: Evict result on s-12: miss_rate dropped from 42% -> 18% and p95 on that node improved ~35%. Looks promising.

Priya R: Canary patch applied; canary logs show batching back to legacy policy and no upshift. Monitoring p95 cluster-wide.

ops-bot: Alert: p99 latency in us-east-1 decreased 40% at 1782504523 after canary.

Alex G: Great. Proceed with staged rollout to rest of pool and bump route back in 10% steps, watching p99 and KV miss rate. Keep me posted on any NIC flaps or GPU-restart churn.

Sam T: Will monitor. Note: we should open a follow-up RFC to make batching rollback safer and add simulated traffic tests for cache eviction behavior.

Taylor H: Agreed — I'll schedule postmortem and cost analysis (extra cross-region egress while shifted).

Alex G: Thanks team :thumbsup: — timeline: detect 1782504300, initial partial shift 1782504365, canary patch 1782504410, meaningful improvement 1782504523. Closing thread after rollout completes and postmortem scheduled.
